_doc: Hand-authored half of the UI/UX source catalog (spec uiux-agent-enrichment.md, Story 1). It holds ONLY judgement: which source, which category, what we take, which agent setting receives it, the source-conflict ledger and which shipped skills are deliberately taste-only. Licence, last-activity date, archived state and stars are NOT written here; `bun scripts/uiux-sources.ts fetch` reads them from the GitHub API and writes catalog.json. A web-only source (no repo) has no machine-readable licence, so it is always reference only and must be a canonical standard. `textUrl` points the corpus at the page with the substance when the README is not it.

tasteOnlySkills.delight: personality and surprise — taste, no standard to cite
tasteOnlySkills.bolder: amplify visual intensity — taste, no standard to cite
tasteOnlySkills.quieter: reduce visual intensity — taste, no standard to cite
tasteOnlySkills.teach-impeccable: one-time setup that records project design context — no external guidance applies

conflicts.default: Web: 24×24 CSS px floor, 44×44 recommended. Telegram Mini App: follow the host OS (44pt iOS, 48dp Android). Native: HIG 44pt / M3 48dp.
conflicts.reason: WCAG 2.5.8 is a legal floor, not a comfort target; users of a Mini App or native app expect their OS's targets.

conflicts.default: Web: browser history. Telegram Mini App: Telegram BackButton, never an in-page back arrow. iOS: navigation-bar back + edge swipe. Android: system/predictive back.
conflicts.reason: Each host owns back; a second, in-page back control conflicts with it and breaks gestures.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group — 10 usability heuristics
sources.takeaway: Heuristic names used to tag every audit finding. Severity: NN/g 0–4 maps to council P-levels as 4→P1, 3→P2, 1–2→P3 (0 = not a problem), so one review carries one scale.

sources.title: Front-End Checklist
sources.takeaway: Pre-ship hygiene checklist (head metadata, forms, images, performance) as review prompts — not a usability method.

sources.title: Awesome Design Principles
sources.takeaway: Survey of published design principles across companies.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2 (source repository)
sources.takeaway: Success criteria cited by number in a11y findings; 2.5.8 target size (24px minimum).

sources.title: W3C ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
sources.takeaway: Keyboard and role contracts for composite widgets (menu, tabs, combobox, dialog).

sources.title: ETSI EN 301 549 — accessibility requirements for ICT
sources.takeaway: Non-web clauses (native apps, documents) that extend WCAG for mobile screens.

sources.title: W3C Accessible Platform Architectures WG
sources.takeaway: Cognitive-accessibility and media notes beyond WCAG success criteria.

sources.title: axe-core
sources.takeaway: Rendered-UI rule engine for the council-review a11y scan (run as a tool, not vendored).

sources.title: Pa11y
sources.takeaway: Comparison point for scan outcomes and CI reporting shape.

sources.title: The A11Y Project
sources.takeaway: Plain-language checklist for the manual items axe cannot see.

sources.title: IBM Equal Access toolkit
sources.takeaway: Rule-to-WCAG mapping and the needs-review outcome class.

sources.title: Accessibility Insights for Web
sources.takeaway: Assisted manual test steps (tab stops, landmarks) for the manual checklist.

sources.title: Lighthouse
sources.takeaway: Audit categories and the split between lab metrics and manual audits.

sources.title: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y
sources.takeaway: Static JSX rules (clickable div without role, label association) as aura-check rule candidates.

sources.title: Stylelint
sources.takeaway: Patterns for colour and spacing lint rules (no raw hex outside tokens).

sources.title: Nu HTML Checker
sources.takeaway: Markup validity checks that precede any a11y scan.

sources.title: webhint
sources.takeaway: Hint catalogue for compatibility, a11y and performance with fix guidance.

sources.title: web-vitals
sources.takeaway: INP / CLS / LCP thresholds for responsiveness findings.

sources.title: Design Tokens Community Group — format module
sources.canonical: W3C Design Tokens Format Module (community group report)
sources.takeaway: Token types and alias semantics for the semantic token ladder.

sources.title: Radix Colors
sources.takeaway: 12-step scale with a stated job per step (backgrounds, borders, solid, text).

sources.title: Radix Themes
sources.takeaway: Dark-mode surface and panel elevation handled by scale steps, not shadows.

sources.title: Primer Primitives
sources.takeaway: Functional token naming (fgColor-muted, bgColor-inset) and high-contrast themes.

sources.title: Carbon Design System
sources.takeaway: Layering model and 2x grid spacing scale; empty-state, loading and notification patterns.

sources.title: Material Web components
sources.takeaway: Material 3 tonal elevation and state-layer tokens as implemented.

sources.title: shadcn/ui
sources.takeaway: CSS-variable theme contract common in agent-built React UIs.

sources.title: Style Dictionary
sources.takeaway: Token build pipeline reference for multi-platform output.

sources.title: Adobe Spectrum design data (tokens)
sources.takeaway: Platform scale sets (desktop vs mobile) for touch-target sizing.

sources.title: Fluent UI
sources.takeaway: Comparison point for elevation and focus-indicator tokens.

sources.title: Harmony (OKLCH palette)
sources.takeaway: Perceptually even OKLCH scales with consistent contrast per step.

sources.title: GOV.UK Design System
sources.takeaway: Error-message and error-summary patterns (say what happened and how to fix it), question-page structure, start pages and "check your answers" before submit.

sources.title: Vale prose linter
sources.takeaway: Rule format for machine-checkable microcopy rules.

sources.title: alex — insensitive writing linter
sources.takeaway: Inclusive-language checks for UI copy.

sources.title: Mailchimp Content Style Guide
sources.takeaway: Voice-and-tone guidance for interface copy.

sources.title: BackstopJS
sources.takeaway: Scenario/viewport matrix shape for screenshot comparison.

sources.title: Lost Pixel
sources.takeaway: Storybook/page visual-regression workflow.

sources.title: Playwright visual comparisons
sources.takeaway: Masking dynamic regions and per-project viewports in screenshot assertions.

sources.title: Storybook
sources.takeaway: Story-per-state isolation, the model behind Aura's Playground.

sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
sources.takeaway: 44pt targets, Dynamic Type, safe areas; sheets vs full-screen modality, tab bar vs sidebar, edge-swipe back, permission priming before the system prompt, destructive confirmation via action sheet; adaptive layout across size classes.

sources.title: Material Design 3
sources.takeaway: 48dp targets, tonal elevation, system and predictive back, navigation bar vs rail vs drawer by window size class, bottom sheets, snackbar vs dialog, motion tokens and reduced motion.

sources.title: Material Components for Android
sources.takeaway: Component-level accessibility defaults on Android.

sources.title: Telegram Mini Apps (Bot API WebApp docs)
sources.takeaway: BackButton/MainButton/SecondaryButton, themeParams, safe-area + contentSafeAreaInset, viewport expand()/isExpanded and viewportStableHeight (the keyboard resizes the viewport), disableVerticalSwipes when content scrolls, fullscreen, closing confirmation, native popups, HapticFeedback for confirmations.

sources.title: tma.js (Telegram Mini Apps SDK)
sources.takeaway: Typed wrappers that show which platform events a Mini App must handle.

sources.title: UI UX Pro Max skill
sources.takeaway: Vendored skill: searchable style/palette/UX-guideline data for agents.

sources.title: tasteskill (design-taste-frontend)
sources.takeaway: Vendored skill: art direction, house rules and the look-and-fix screenshot loop.

sources.title: impeccable
sources.takeaway: Upstream of the repo's audit/polish/critique/… skills (skills-lock.json).

sources.title: Anthropic skills (frontend-design and others)
sources.takeaway: Skill authoring shape and the frontend-design skill as a comparison point.

sources.title: Vercel agent skills (web design guidelines)
sources.takeaway: Web-interface guideline list as a comparison point for aura-check rules.

sources.title: NN/g — Severity ratings for usability problems
sources.takeaway: Severity as frequency × impact × persistence; the 0–4 scale behind audit severities.

sources.title: NN/g — Usability testing 101
sources.takeaway: Task-based usability-test protocol: realistic tasks, think-aloud, facilitator neutrality, 5-user rounds.

sources.title: GOV.UK Service Manual — user research
sources.canonical: GOV.UK Service Manual (UK Government Digital Service)
sources.takeaway: Planning research rounds, task success measurement and testing with users who have access needs.

sources.title: Google developer documentation style guide
sources.takeaway: UI-text conventions: button and link labels, error wording, sentence case, second person.

sources.title: TelegramUI — Mini App component kit
sources.takeaway: iOS- vs Android-flavoured Mini App components following the host platform's look.

sources.title: Microsoft Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.canonical: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction (Amershi et al., CHI 2019)
sources.takeaway: 18 guidelines: make clear what the AI can do and how well, support efficient correction and dismissal, explain why, scope services when in doubt.

sources.title: Google PAIR — People + AI Guidebook
sources.takeaway: Mental models, explainability and trust calibration, feedback and control, errors and graceful failure for AI features.
